description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Holy)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dalmascan Captain Mode I (Basch)] and [Holy/Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Dalmascan Captain Mode I (Basch)
description.text: Holy and Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 after using 1/2/3+ Holy or Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dalmascan Captain Mode II (Basch)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Dalmascan Captain Mode I (Basch)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Dalmascan Captain Mode II (Basch)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Holy and Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100%, grants [Deadly Strikes +10% 1] to all allies with any Attach Holy or Attach Fire after using Holy or Fire abilities

description.name: Deadly Strikes +10% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 10% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient and other Critical Damage statuses)

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Fire/Holy ability

description.name: Holy/Fire Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Holy and Fire abilities deal 5% more damage
